definitions.transition_ms: 1000*(CHARGED-PREINSTALLED); includes native transition and cache-conditioning differences
definitions.native_call_ms: Full synchronized native transfer/commit call, including CPU preparation, copies and map update; not network time
definitions.future_peak_assignment_reduction: Mean per-input maximum rank assignment count under KEEP minus PREINSTALLED, from exact native mapper diagnostics
definitions.active_experts: Physical slots with positive assignments in each input, averaged over inputs and ranks; rankwise means also retained
definitions.state: One split/block/regime/batch source snapshot, verified equal across candidate families, horizons and technical repetitions
definitions.independence: Source-document blocks are units; regimes, batch sizes, horizons, arms and technical repetitions are correlated
definitions.limits: No confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, policy decisions, causal component attribution or final-data tuning
